item_person: John Cavadini, church historian and medievalist affiliated with the University of Notre Dame.

evidence.says: LC identifies the author of The Last Christology of the West and the Notre Dame professor; Saints (2023) contributor data and the Copyright catalog supply 1953.
Item describes a church historian and medievalist, lists Notre Dame as employer and n93008709 as LC ID. P569 stores +2000 with precision 7 (century), not an exact birth year.
